a.lede: Russia’s Cosmos 2612 moved from more than 200 miles to about three miles from ICEYE-X36, a U.S.-owned radar satellite.
a.title: Russian military satellite closes from 200 miles to 3 miles of US radar craft aiding Ukraine

b.lede: "Kosmos 2612 closed from hundreds of kilometers away to extreme proximity to ICEYE-X36."
b.title: Russian spacecraft maneuvers in "extreme proximity" to satellite used by Ukraine
